description.en: A list of addresses in the address pool.

description.zh:
地址归属信息，JSON化字符串格式。

- LineCode：归属线路Code（已废弃，以lineCodes数据为准）
- lineCodes：归属线路Code列表
- lineCodeRectifyType：归属线路订正类型，默认：自动订正
    - NO_NEED 不订正
    - RECTIFIED 已订正
    - AUTO 自动订正
description.en:
The source region of the address. This parameter is a JSON string.

- LineCode: The line code of the source region. This parameter is deprecated. Use lineCodes instead.

- lineCodes: A list of line codes for the source regions.

- lineCodeRectifyType: The type of line code rectification. Default value: AUTO. Valid values:

  - NO\_NEED: No rectification is required.

  - RECTIFIED: The line code is rectified.

  - AUTO: The line code is automatically rectified.

description.zh:
模式：

- SMART：智能返回
- ONLINE：永远在线
- OFFLINE：永远离线
description.en:
The mode. Valid values:

- SMART: Smart return

- ONLINE: Always online

- OFFLINE: Always offline

description.zh:
地址池id。<props="china">可通过调用[DescribeDnsGtmInstanceAddressPools ](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstanceaddresspools?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-29697.d_0_5_1_3_9_7.1cee430dbd1I3y)获取</props>
<props="intl">可通过调用[DescribeDnsGtmInstanceAddressPools ](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstanceaddresspools?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
description.en: The ID of the address pool. For more information, see [DescribeDnsGtmInstanceAddressPools](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstanceaddresspools).

description.zh: 部分返回参数语言。默认值：en。取值范围：en、zh、ja。
description.en: The language of the response. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

description.zh:
负载均衡策略：

- ALL_RR: 返回全部地址
- RATIO：按权重返回地址
description.en:
The load balancing policy. Valid values:

- ALL\_RR: Returns all addresses.

- RATIO: Returns addresses by weight.
The name of the address pool.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-dns-gtm-address-pool --lang en --addr-pool-id testp000000 --name testpoolname --lba-strategy ALL_RR --addr AttributeInfo=Linecode:_default_lineCodes：_default_lineCodeRectifyType:_AUTO LbaWeight=1 Mode=SMART Addr=1.1.XX.XX Remark=test --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns UpdateDnsGtmAddressPool --region cn-hangzhou --Addr.1.AttributeInfo 'Linecode:_default_lineCodes：_default_lineCodeRectifyType:_AUTO' --LbaStrategy ALL_RR --Addr.1.Mode SMART --AddrPoolId testp000000 --Lang en --Addr.1.LbaWeight 1 --Addr.1.Addr '1.1.XX.XX' --Addr.1.Remark test --Name testpoolname
